# Cadet AI

> Cadet AI is an independent study-aid Android app for UK Army Cadet Force (ACF) and Combined Cadet Force (CCF) cadets aged 13 and over. Its built-in AI assistant, TANGO, answers training questions grounded in the cadet syllabus and is designed not to make things up (it says when it is unsure). The app adds quizzes across 10 subjects from Basic to 4-Star, XP, military ranks, 100+ badges, 35 awards, opt-in leaderboards, and read-aloud / neural voice. It is not an official MOD, ACF, CCF or Cadet Forces product and is not endorsed by them. Coming soon to Google Play.

## Key facts
- Platform: Android only (no iOS/iPhone version yet). Coming soon to Google Play; not yet released.
- Audience: cadets aged 13+; under-13s cannot create an account. Also useful to parents/guardians and unit staff.
- Pricing: Free "Cadet" plan; Plus (£3.99/month or £29.99/year); Pro (£9.99/month or £74.99/year). Monthly Plus and Pro each include a 7-day free trial. No ads, no third-party analytics trackers, data never sold.
- Subjects covered: Drill & Turnout, Fieldcraft & Tactics, First Aid, Navigation, Shooting, Skill at Arms, Military Knowledge, Communications & IT, Keeping Active, Community Engagement.
- TANGO: a grounded AI study assistant that sticks to cadet training and won't make things up; 20 selectable characters; optional lifelike neural voices in British, American, Australian and Indian accents (Plus/Pro).
- Privacy: national and unit leaderboards are opt-in and off by default.
